item.title: USM receives small funding increase from Maryland’s 2027 budget proposal
item.description: The governor’s almost $71 billion budget plan allocates $7.92 billion for USM’s operating budget, for less than a quarter of a percent increase from last year.

item.title: Meet Maryland men’s basketball’s ‘culture coach,’ a one-of-a-kind staffer
item.description: After four job titles and three schools, Josh Chambers has evolved into an indispensable figure on Buzz Williams’ staff.

item.title: UPDATED: Building, hot water temperatures rising after UMD resolves steam outage
item.description: The steam outage had left nearly all buildings on the University of Maryland campus with reduced heat and no hot water.

item.title: UMD closure extends to Thursday, Friday
item.description: Facilities Management is also still working to address the widespread steam, heat and hot water outage that began early Wednesday morning.

item.title: UMD asks resident students to relocate amid heat, hot water outage
item.description: Hours after Facilities Management resolved a widespread steam outage, the university’s Central Energy Plant lost steam service for the second time in a day.

item.title: No. 16 Maryland women’s basketball drops third straight in 83-80 double-overtime loss to No. 25 Washington
item.description: The Terps didn’t convert a single field goal in the final three minutes of their second straight overtime defeat.

item.title: College Park City Council backs new affordable senior housing project
item.description: The project would be financed in part through a federal tax credit that would require all units to remain affordable for at least 30 years.

item.title: PHOTOS: UMD students enjoy snowy start to the semester
item.description: After winter storm Fern passed through Maryland, students spent the first few days off enjoying the snow.

item.title: Maryland House committee advances congressional redistricting bill
item.description: If passed, the bill would redraw Maryland’s eight congressional districts ahead of the 2026 midterm election.

item.title: Take a look at UMD’s campus protests over the last 60 years
item.description: The Diamondback searched through reporting archives spanning six decades to summarize some of the biggest student protests covered.
